title: Resonance Pact
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji stood alone at the crossroads of destiny, on the distant horizon, a name he had long believed dead was slowly emerging with the first light of dawn...

text.content: Golden light burst from Chen Ji's body like tangible substance, and the threads of destiny that had been entwined around him were now intertwining with another figure in an utterly不可思议 manner—that was the thousand-year thread of destiny belonging to the Demon Path Commander, now slowly merging into his body. The moment the two threads of destiny collided, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented surge of power, as if the entire heavens and earth were trembling for him alone.

dialogue.content: Is this... the true form of destiny's resonance?

text.content: Chen Ji felt that mighty power surging through his meridians, as if every inch of his skin was being reshaped by the laws of heaven and earth. Yet amidst the狂热 of this power, he detected something amiss—the thread of destiny intertwined with him was dissipating at a heart-stopping speed. The resonance of destiny was, after all, fueled by the annihilation of one party.

dialogue.content: (The Demon Path Commander's form grew increasingly ethereal, yet his voice rang like a great bell) Chen Ji, you have seen my destiny. A thousand years of solitude, a thousand years of perseverance... was it worth it?

text.content: Within those interwoven threads of destiny, Chen Ji witnessed countless scenes flash by like a carousel—he saw the Demon Path Commander as a spirited young man ten thousand years ago, witnessed his rage and despair when betrayed by the Holy Sect, and saw his lonely existence of guarding the Demon Realm for ten thousand years, merely waiting for someone to stand beside him. What kind of loneliness was this? Ten thousand years of time, alone in vigil, watching the world transform through countless cycles, yet no one to hear a single word.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was low yet firm) Senior... why did you choose me?

text.content: The threads of destiny began flooding into Chen Ji's body at a frantic pace, those powers containing ten thousand years of cultivation and wisdom surging through him like a breached dam. Chen Ji felt his spiritual consciousness expanding at an incredible speed, as if the entire heavens and earth were now within his perception. Yet at the same time, that figure who had guarded the Demon Realm for ten thousand years was becoming increasingly faint and illusory.

dialogue.content: (The Demon Path Commander's voice was now like a candle in the wind) Because... the moment your destiny intertwined with mine... I saw hope. Not your power, not your wisdom... but the light in your eyes. That was... something I had long lost.

text.content: Chen Ji sensed the true form of that power within him—it was the ultimate power beyond all his previous understanding, 'Heavenly Fate Unity,' capable of wielding the force of destiny for one's own purposes. Yet at this moment, his Tianji Record Fragment was also trembling violently, as if sensing the call of fate. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul churned intensely within the Tianji Record, seemingly transmitting some kind of warning.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a flash of understanding in his eyes) Wait... Senior, you're saying... this resonance ritual is actually an inheritance?

text.content: Yet at this very moment, the price of destiny was fully revealed—the Demon Path Commander's form had become so faint it was nearly transparent, barely maintaining a illusory outline. Yet at this final moment, Chen Ji saw a flicker of a smile in that figure's eyes—the relief of finally finding liberation after ten thousand years of solitude, the contentment of entrusting hope to a successor.

choice.prompt: Facing the Demon Path Commander who was about to fall into eternal slumber, Chen Ji had to make a choice—accept this gift of destiny entirely, or attempt to find a mutually beneficial solution?

choices.description: Seriously accept the thousand-year accumulation and expectations of the Demon Path Commander, vowing to watch over the world's common people for him, ensuring his perseverance was not in vain.
choices.visible_cost: Lose an ally who truly understood him
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ultimate ability 'Heavenly Fate Unity,' expand spiritual consciousness to perceive the Three Realms, and achieve a quantum leap in combat power
choices.risk_hint: From now on, he must face all future storms and machinations alone

text.content: Chen Ji slowly knelt, bowing with the most solemn courtesy to that figure about to dissipate. His voice was low and firm, each word seemingly carved into heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was steady as mountains) Junior Chen Ji today receives your mantle, and shall never disappoint. When chaos befalls the world, I shall act without hesitation; when the Demon Realm has a rift, I shall personally mend it. Senior... please rest in eternal peace.

choices.description: Attempt to use the power of the Tianji Record to share the cost of resonance, so the Demon Path Commander need not fall completely asleep, even if there is only a glimmer of hope.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value, and may damage one's foundation
choices.visible_reward: If successful, the Demon Path Commander will remain as a remnant soul, able to provide guidance at crucial moments in the future
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Tianji Record may be insufficient to shake ten thousand years of karmic causality

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly stood, the Tianji Record Fragment flying from his body, blooming with dazzling light in the air. He was going to use his own power to shake this seemingly irreversible karmic chain of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's gaze burned like torches) Senior, wait! I will not accept this ending! If destiny is unjust, then I shall rewrite destiny! Tianji Record—give me strength!

choices.memory_label: 试图分担命运时的执念

text.content: Regardless of what choice Chen Ji made, the final stage of the resonance ritual finally arrived. The golden light, after reaching its peak, began to slowly收敛, and that figure which had guarded the Demon Realm for ten thousand years also completely turned into scattered starlight at this moment. Those starlight fragments drifted down slowly, like a final farewell, yet also like eternal guardianship.

Yet at the very last moment before the starlight dissipated, Chen Ji heard that voice which was about to sink into eternal slumber forever. The voice was as light as a sigh, yet it was clearly carved into the depths of his soul—that was the Demon Path Commander's final words, and also the tenderness of his first time opening his heart to another in ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: (The Demon Path Commander's voice was like the last leaf falling in the wind, so faint it was almost inaudible, yet crystal clear) Chen Ji... live... for me... see... the final... appearance of this heaven and earth...

text.content: The moment the words fell, that figure completely dissipated between heaven and earth. Yet as he dissipated, Chen Ji felt the truly complete form of that power within him—it was the ultimate power beyond everything, 'Heavenly Fate Unity,' the mysterious ability to rewrite destiny itself. Yet at the same time, an unprecedented loneliness also surged into Chen Ji's heart.

From now on, he would face all future storms and challenges alone. The thousand-year accumulation of the Demon Path Commander had already become part of his power, yet the ally who understood him and fought alongside him had forever fallen into slumber. The price of this power was far heavier than Chen Ji had imagined. Yet he knew this was the responsibility he must bear, and also his promise to that senior.

choice.prompt: Facing this heavy power and a lonely future, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—what would he do next?

choices.description: 收拾心情，继续踏上寻找妹妹陈念的道路，将对魔道主帅的怀念化为前行的动力。
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the expanded spiritual consciousness ability, allowing perception of danger and opportunity within a greater range
choices.risk_hint: Awaiting him ahead are the conflicts between the Three Great Sects and unknown dangers

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the surging grief. He raised his head, and his gaze became cold and firm once more—this was his path, and no matter how many thorns lay ahead, he could only move forward without retreat.

choices.description: 带着新获得的力量回到天青宗，暗中观察凌渊的动向，确认老掌门的真实意图。
choices.visible_reward: Can secretly arrange preparations for the future showdown
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have already sensed the anomaly

text.content: Chen Ji收敛全身气息，重新化为了那个毫不起眼的废材弟子模样。他要回到天青宗，以新的身份继续他的布局——而这一次，他将带着足以颠覆一切的力量。

As Chen Ji made his decision, far away in the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, a pair of eyes that had been dormant for countless years slowly opened. Those eyes flickered with a dark glow, as if capable of seeing through endless space and time, gazing upon that land where destiny's resonance had just been completed. Ling Yuan's lips curved into a meaningful smile, carrying a difficult-to-describe anticipation and calculation.

And at the same time, within the aftermath of the dissipated destiny resonance, Chen Ji sensed a subtle change—that was a fluctuation from the depths of the Tianji Record, as if some dormant secret was slowly awakening. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly within the Fragment, seemingly transmitting some ancient information. Chen Ji knew his journey was just beginning—ahead awaited the conflicts of the Three Great Sects, the invasion of the Demonic Path, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land, and the无形注视 of that ultimate antagonist, the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao.' And he would, within this chaotic world, weave a chess game that none could break.
